requirement: Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
description: Establish and communicate a code of conduct; require acknowledgment by all personnel.
evidence_examples: Signed code of conduct, employee handbook, training records

description: Board/governance committee oversees the design and operation of internal controls.
Document org chart, roles, and responsibilities for security.
evidence_examples: Org chart, RACI matrix, job descriptions

description: Maintain accurate inventories of systems, data, and vendors.
evidence_examples: Asset inventory, data inventory, vendor list

requirement: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
description: Security policies published and communicated to all staff.
Communicate security commitments to customers and vendors.
Perform formal risk assessments at least annually.
Include fraud scenarios in risk assessment.
Change-driven risk reviews for new systems/products.
Internal audits and continuous control monitoring.
Maintain a control catalog mapped to risks.
Implement IT general controls (access, change, ops).

requirement: Logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures
description: Enforce authentication, MFA, least privilege across systems.
Formal access provisioning workflow with approvals.
Badge access, visitor logs at facilities/data centers.

requirement: Logical access security measures against external threats
Restrict transmission, movement, removal of information
description: Encrypt data in transit; DLP controls.
Documented IR plan with defined roles.

requirement: Authorize, design, develop, configure, document, test, approve, and implement changes
description: Change management process with approvals and testing.
evidence_examples: Change tickets, peer reviews, test evidence

requirement: Identify, select, and develop risk mitigation activities
Vendor and business partner risk management
description: Vendor due diligence, DPAs, ongoing monitoring.
evidence_examples: Vendor risk assessments, SOC2 reports of vendors

requirement: Obtain or generate accurate, complete, relevant information
Store inputs and outputs completely and accurately

description: Data retention schedule and purge process.
Mechanisms to maintain accurate personal data.
